n: Samsung Galaxy Tab A with S Pen

cs.t: For a cheaper & smaller alternative, also worth looking at the Samsung Galaxy Tab A with S-Pen 8.0.  Convoluted name, but I love it, and it is dramatically cheaper than an iPad Pro.  I think it compares favorably too, I've tried both & I don't feel the Galaxy Tab lags too far behind the iPad Pro in latency.  I'm not a heavy writer, but for me it has replaced paper note-taking during phone calls or webinars, or times when I need to sketch or write an idea out on paper (sometimes I find typing doesn't help me solve a coding problem, but writing with a pen does - writing on the Galaxy Tab is giving me that same mental shift).  And of course it syncs with Evernote & you can resize/move objects you've sketched and all the other good things.
